explain.markdown:
This sentence describes the core mathematical procedure of "Scaled Dot-Product Attention." First, the system calculates the dot product between a "query" (a representation of what you are looking for) and every "key" (a representation of what is available in the input).

Next, this result (the dot product) is divided by the square root of the dimension of the keys ($\sqrt{d_k}$). This division is called "scaling" and is done to prevent the dot products from becoming too large, which helps keep the next step—applying a softmax function—stable and effective.

Finally, the softmax function is applied to these scaled dot products. The softmax function converts these raw numbers into weights that are all positive and sum up to 1, which are then used to weigh the corresponding "values" to get the final attention output.
